acceptance: A1: The canonical report identifies japanese-final-reassessment-20260729 with workItemRole final_reassessment, and Markdown labels it as the final reassessment rather than an assessment-definition corrective.

A2: The complete 12-case Japanese repository-governance matrix is regenerated from the synchronized post-corrective main, binds every declared stable evidence file by SHA-256, and has zero blockingFindings.

A3: Japanese input trust, injection, Unicode/encoding/path handling, Wizard/CLI, Cockpit Status, PR/Task Outcome, installation/calibration/upgrade/rollback/uninstall lifecycle, and multilingual documentation evidence all remain executable and passing.

A4: The checked-in JSON and derived Markdown are deterministic, mutually aligned, stale on any bound-byte drift, stable on unrelated drift, and accepted only when every bound file matches the asserted exact source commit.
A5: General provider/model Japanese fluency and native-human translation quality remain explicit limitations and are never promoted to passed capability claims.

A6: Every non-zero blocker, if discovered, is recorded with a stable finding ID and receives a separate corrective Work Item before this reassessment can complete; a zero-blocker result is supported by direct machine evidence rather than inference.
A7: PLAN-DIRECTIVE-039, the comprehensive plan, Contract, implementation, reports, tests, Summary, and acceptance evidence map bidirectionally without deleting historical corrective identities.

A8: Full quality, ai-finish archive, aggregate PR verification, exact-Head Hosted checks, merge, ai-close-work-item, local/remote branch deletion, detached worktree removal, and synchronized clean main complete before documentation alignment starts.
A9: This Work Item changes no capability truth status, Japanese product behavior beyond assessment identity, release metadata, tag, GitHub Release, or later-stage completion state.
guidelines: Japanese-speaking engineers are a required audience; do not infer Japanese capability from English-only behavior.
Evidence over self-declaration: every pass must remain bound to source, test, command, and exact-source evidence.
Treat missing, stale, ambiguous, English-inferred, or non-executable Japanese evidence as blocking.
Keep general Japanese model fluency and native-human translation quality as explicit non-claims.
Do not combine a newly discovered capability remediation with this final assessment.
Preserve the Capability Truth Matrix as the sole authority for current implementation status.
rawUserRequest: Continue the approved serial plan. Japanese capability is mandatory before release. Complete a comprehensive Japanese evaluation after every corrective closes; if any problem is found, record and correct it through a separate complete Work Item lifecycle before continuing.
